source.title: Senior Delegate Announcement - Latin America (March 2022)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Senior Delegate in Latin America. **Marlon de V. Marques** will become the new Senior Delegate in this region.

We wish Marlon best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

There was one other candidate who applied for the position:

- Areli Rubi Gordillo Martínez

You can find their candidacy documents [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VjOhO0qiVCUk4Ab4zCH2B64eHgpt392b).

translation.title: 拉丁美洲高级代表任命公告（2022 年 3 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，**Marlon de V. Marques** 将出任拉丁美洲地区的新任高级代表。

祝 Marlon 在新的岗位上一切顺利。

这一职位还有一位申请人：

- Areli Rubi Gordillo Martínez

两人的申请材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VjOhO0qiVCUk4Ab4zCH2B64eHgpt392b)查看。
